==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=OpenXml&min=OpenXml&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.OpenXml: the paper size used when a document states none. Left null it follows the
        // machine's region, so a rendered page would differ between a US and a European agent.
        // False is A4, true is US Letter. It only matters once a render backend is referenced.
        VerifyOpenXml.UseLetterPageSize = false;

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/OpenXmlTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=OpenXml&min=OpenXml&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using DocumentFormat.OpenXml.Packaging;

// Verify.OpenXml: Verifies Word, Excel and PowerPoint files: text, a csv per sheet, properties, a deterministic copy and page renders.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.OpenXml
// Note: One verification writes several targets: an info txt, the text or a csv per sheet, the
// deterministic binary, and a png per page once a backend is referenced.
// Note: Png rendering needs exactly one of Morph.Skia or Morph.ImageSharp. With neither, rendering
// is silently skipped; with both, the first verification throws.
// Note: The backend is found by probing for the assembly, so switching it is a package change
// only; no code changes.
// Note: Rendering is compiled in on net10.0 only, because Morph targets net10.0.
// Note: Rendered pages depend on the installed fonts, so set VerifyOpenXml.FontDirectory to a
// bundled font folder and generate the .verified.png files on one canonical machine.
// Note: Page counts differ per format: Word is one page per laid out page, PowerPoint one per
// slide in p:sldIdLst order, and Excel follows the print layout rather than the sheet.
// Note: pptx is verified the same way, by passing a stream with the extension pptx or a
// PresentationDocument.
// Note: UniqueForOSPlatform() is worth adding once rendering is on and the tests run on more than
// one OS.
public class OpenXmlTests
{
    // The extension passed to Verify decides which converter runs. A docx writes an info file
    // with the document properties, the extracted text, and a deterministic copy of the file.
    [Fact]
    public Task Word()
    {
        return Verify(WordDocument.Build(), "docx");
    }

    // A workbook writes one .verified.csv per sheet, plus an info file listing the sheets and
    // their columns, so a changed cell shows up as a one line diff.
    [Fact]
    public Task Excel()
    {
        return Verify(ExcelDocument.Build(), "xlsx");
    }
}

==== interactions

Warning transitive-sponsorship: Morph carries an Open Source Maintenance Fee check of its own, for Papyrine, and Papyrine does not offer the exemption claimed for Verify, and accepts only SmallRevenue and MaintainerConsulting. The generated Directory.Build.props has that owner's options commented out; until one is chosen the build fails with SC021.
